summary: [[character:bart]], a new Bob from [[character:calvin]]'s first cohort at [[location:alpha-centauri]], makes his first [[technology:subspace-communications|SCUT]] call to [[character:bill]], who drops uninvited into Bart's log-cabin [[technology:vr]] and welcomes him to [[organization:bobnet]]. Bart reports that Calvin and [[character:goku]] scouted [[location:alpha-centauri-a]] and B as planned, found the wreckage of a [[organization:united-states-of-eurasia]] probe and [[technology:autofactory]] at B, and used the improved version-3 Heavens in a sneak attack that wiped out a working Brazilian factory at A, though one Brazilian probe, probably unfinished, escaped. The system is good for resources but has no livable planets. Calvin and Goku set up a Bob factory and moved on once a new Bob could take over, and Bart built the SCUT after receiving Bill's transmission. Bill worries that [[character:ernesto-medeiros|Medeiros]] may hijack another installation or later raid Alpha Centauri, but with early warning systems in place and no way to track him, he lets it go, relieved that a Bob factory is finally running. Bart promises to drop by for Scrub baseball, and with two more Bobs being completed there will at last be enough players to fill the outfield.

introducing.name: BobNet
introducing.description: A SCUT-based network linking [[character:bob-replicant]] replicants across star systems. Newly contacted Bobs are welcomed into it, and it provides instant communications up to about twenty-five light-years.

updates.description: A nearby stellar system considered an obvious first destination for an interstellar probe. It is good for resources but has no colonizable or livable planets. It pairs [[location:alpha-centauri-a]], with one planet in its comfort zone, and [[location:alpha-centauri-b]], with a small inner planet and two asteroid belts, where the wreckage of a [[organization:united-states-of-eurasia|USE]] vessel is found. [[character:calvin]] and [[character:goku]] destroy a [[organization:brazilian-empire|Brazilian]] probe factory at the A star in a sneak attack.
updates.state: Overseen by [[character:bart]], a Bob from the Bob factory that [[character:calvin]] and [[character:goku]] set up after destroying the Brazilian installation; early warning systems now monitor the system.

updates.description: The A star component of the [[location:alpha-centauri]] system, surveyed by [[character:goku]]. A Brazilian factory building probes operated there until [[character:calvin]] and Goku destroyed it in a sneak attack.
